others.route: Autorización de presentación de artistas extranjeros (Dirección de Espectáculos Públicos)

note: Guatemala: a foreign artist's presentation is authorised by the Culture and Sports Ministry's Public Spectacles Directorate, on the organiser's application with the Guatemalan Artist's Social Security Institute's (IPSA) guarantee stamps (Acuerdos Ministeriales 1106-2015 and 544-2016). The Migration Institute's own status for a touring artist under the Código de Migración wasn't found. No days of performing without the authorisation are named.
